title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Information Technology Management (Level 7)
description: The IPGD in Information Technology Management course equips professionals with the strategic and practical skills needed to lead and optimize IT resources, drive digital transformation, and foster innovation within organizations.
longDescription: The IPGD in Information Technology Management course aims to furnish professionals with strategic insights and practical skills to lead IT resources effectively, steering through digital transformation complexities and leveraging technology for innovation and organizational success. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The International Postgraduate Diploma Programme in Information Technology Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 9 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma Programme in Information Technology Management focus on equipping professionals with practical IT management expertise to navigate digital complexities and drive innovation within organizations. This qualification reflects current practices in Information Technology Management and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of Information Technology Management. Course Details: Business Research Methods: Teaches research techniques to support data-driven IT management decisions. People Analytics and Big Data: Explores using big data and analytics to optimize workforce management in IT environments. Data Analytics and Strategies: Focuses on leveraging data analysis to create strategic IT initiatives. Management Information System: Covers the development and management of IT systems to enhance organizational operations and decision-making. Agile Project Management: Introduces agile methodologies for managing IT projects with flexibility and efficiency. Operation and Information System: Integrates IT management with operational processes to boost efficiency and performance. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level.
This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.
entry: Hold an honors degree in a related field, possess a UK Level 6 diploma, or possess an equivalent overseas qualification, such as a bachelor's degree or Higher National Diploma. OR

Mature learners, aged over 25, can apply without the aforementioned qualifications if they have a minimum of five years of relevant experience. However, the acceptance of such cases is subject to individual review on a case-by-case basis.

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from Partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
